versions.changelog:
Initial release of video-understanding skill.

- Enables AI to analyze and summarize video content from popular platforms (YouTube, Bilibili, etc.)
- Extracts video title, description, duration, and key points
- Supports video content summarization and highlights extraction
- Detects user intent based on requests such as "analyze," "summarize," or "extract" video content
- Cannot play videos or process raw visuals; relies on metadata and available APIs
